record.hypothesis: Across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl, change only the loss mixture from 0.8 BPR + 0.2 pointwise logistic to 0.95 BPR + 0.05 pointwise logistic, retaining zero-margin softplus BPR and valid-position averaging. Greater emphasis on relative ranking may improve HR@10 while weak pointwise supervision anchors score magnitudes. Preserve HSTU topology, features, embeddings, readout, scoring, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and training settings; train one independent model per category.
